newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian teachers at 10,000 schools strike.
newsitem.headline: Russian teachers at 10,000 schools strike.

text.p: Russian teachers in more than 10,000 schools went on strike on Monday to demand payment of overdue salaries, union leaders said.

"Teachers are the last in line, the most unprotected and deprived," Communist leader Gennady Zyuganov said at a teachers' demonstration outside Russia's White House government headquarters. "Teachers have been forgotten everywhere."
Many of the several hundred teachers who gathered under steady snow said they had not been paid for months. A few sought donations from passers-by for their schools.
More than three million children would be affected by the strike, Vladimir Yakovlev, head of the Education Workers' Union, told a news conference, Interfax news agency reported.
He said the strike, at 10,260 schools in 56 Russian regions, would last for up to five days.

Teachers in some regions joined miners and medical workers in staging a series of strikes late last year over wage delays. The government, struggling with a shortfall in tax revenues, promised to end the delays but many payments are still behind.
